links.rationale: addTask is the only method that creates and stores a new task, matching the requirement's addTask reference directly.
Defines the exact set of fields a caller may supply when adding a task (title required, everything else optional), which the requirement's acceptance criteria depend on.
completeTask is the only method that sets a task's completed flag to true and records a completion time.
removeTask is the only method that deletes a task from the active list and reports whether a task was actually removed.
reopenTask is the only method that sets completed back to false and clears completedAt on a previously completed task.
updateTask is the only method that changes title, notes, priority, dueDate, or tags on an existing task, leaving id and createdAt untouched and leaving omitted fields unchanged.
Defines which fields exist on a task, and therefore which fields are and aren't editable (e.g. id and createdAt are excluded from what updateTask can change).

The TaskUpdate alias used by updateTask is Partial<CreateTaskInput>, so this interface indirectly defines the shape of an update, but TaskUpdate itself is a `type` alias and is not separately indexed as its own symbol, so this link is an approximation rather than a direct match.
listTasks accepts a filter and, when given a completed value, returns only tasks matching that completion status.
Defines the completed/priority filter shape listTasks accepts.
searchTasks lowercases the query and both fields before comparing, satisfying the case-insensitive title/notes lookup described by the requirement.
getSummary is the only method that computes total/completed/remaining counts over the list.
Defines the exact fields the summary reports (total, completedCount, remainingCount, overdueCount).
planFocusOrder sorts open tasks by priority weight first and, for ties, by nearer due date first, matching the requirement's ordering rule exactly.

listTasksByTag is the only method that retrieves tasks sharing a given tag. This is the domain-vocabulary tier's intended target: the requirement says 'label' where the code says 'tag', and the requirement was deliberately worded to avoid naming this method.
sweepCompleted removes every completed task from the active map and pushes it into the archive, directly satisfying the first acceptance criterion (no finished item remains active).
listArchivedTasks is what makes swept-out tasks retrievable afterward, directly satisfying the requirement's second acceptance criterion.
saveTasksToFile is the only function that writes the task list to durable storage.
loadTasksFromFile is the only function that reconstructs the task list from a previously saved file, completing the round trip the requirement describes.
The JSON encoding step saveTasksToFile relies on; materially necessary but not itself the disk I/O the requirement describes.
The JSON decoding step loadTasksFromFile relies on, including the array-shape validation that guards against a corrupt file.
